# Workspace Setup Instructions

This workspace contains a Vite React app for the Pusti Pure CRM dashboard prototype.

## Setup

- Run `npm install` to install dependencies.
- Run `npm run dev` to start the development server.
- Run `npm run build` to compile the production build.

## Notes

- The app uses Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons.
- The main application code is in `src/App.jsx`.
- Local storage persistence is mocked with `window.storage` if available.
